capabilities: Organize a project into volumes and chapters with step-by-step writing stages
Generate outlines, world-building and entity sets with AI
Co-write at sentence and paragraph level with candidate generation and rewriting
Score chapter quality and check continuity, foreshadowing and pacing
Export the compiled manuscript to Markdown, TXT, HTML, EPUB or DOCX
extras: Desktop only (isDesktopOnly); mobile is not supported in this version. UI is available in Simplified Chinese and English. No telemetry; API keys can be encrypted with a session passphrase. Older body-generation commands are hidden from the command palette and kept until v5.0.0 with deprecation notices.
problem: Long-form fiction needs a structured pipeline from outline through chapter drafting to continuity and quality review, which plain notes and a chat window do not provide.
